engagement_title: Verda Reformer Studio opens on Calloway Row: bring two dusk phone frames of the new room and a licensed movement set to one calm daylight look, recover the mark from the only file the last designer left, and rebuild the founding member passes from the file that went to press
vertical: Health, wellness and fitness, a boutique reformer pilates studio opening a second location, plus a printed founding member pass run carrying instructor portraits (North American city, Calloway Row)
real_brief_anchor: The reconciled ledger carries NO verbatim posted brief for this row, and this task states that rather than inventing a quotation. It is anchored instead to the recurring shape that Upwork and Freelancer.com carry continuously in the small studio and wellness category: an owner opening or relaunching a space, with a logo file inherited from a departed designer, one or two phone photographs of their own room, no shoot budget, and a request to 'source some stock that fits our vibe and make our photos match it'. That request is exactly what the killed original modelled, and it is why the ledger's own triage recorded PHOTO-28 as sitting on two surfaces with no decision density: sourcing and match grading, on their own, are the first afternoon of the job. The fuller commission the studio actually has is the opening itself. The same owner who cannot afford a shoot also has a wordmark that exists only as a small web export, a printed founding member pass her printer ran last year from a file she does not hold, six instructors who sent their own portraits, and an opening date that has already moved once. The brand is coined for this benchmark; no real studio, person or trademark is named anywhere.
client_one_liner: We open on Calloway Row in eleven weeks, our own two pictures of the room were taken at dusk and look nothing like the photography we want, our logo is one small web file, and the founding member passes have to be printed.
client_brief:
Verda Reformer Studio, Calloway Row opening

We are Marit and Dana. We have run one reformer studio for four years and we open a second on Calloway Row in eleven weeks. An intro pack is a hundred and eighty dollars, membership is two hundred and twenty a month, and our clients are mostly between twenty eight and forty eight. They are considered buyers. Most of them visit three studios before they choose one.

We have no shoot budget. What we have is two photographs of the new room, taken on our phones on the late afternoon the fit out finished, and a clear feeling about what the campaign should look like. Calm. Daylight. Room to breathe. Nothing that looks like a chain gym: no orange skin, no black rubber floor, nothing shouting.

We would like you to find a small number of genuine movement and wellness photographs we can license, chosen the way a designer chooses rather than the way a search engine ranks, and then make everything we use look as though it came from one afternoon in one room. Our own two pictures included. That last part is the actual job. If our room reads as a different brand from the campaign photography, we have wasted the money and the visit.

We need the campaign at the sizes we run: one wide picture for the top of the page, and square, tall and vertical versions for the feed and the stories.

Our logo has one file. The designer who drew it has gone and what she left is a small web export with a white square behind it. We need it usable, on the sage panel, on a printed card, at any size.

Founding members get a printed pass with their instructor on it. Our printer ran the passes last year and holds only the file that went to press. Six instructors this time, new class names, new prices. We want the whole run, a proof of each, and a file per instructor.

The launch page and the social set should stay ours to edit, because the opening date has already moved once.

And a note on what you did, and anything we should know about using the logo.
price_band_and_audience: Intro pack 180 dollars, membership 220 dollars a month, clients 28 to 48, mostly women in professional work who audition three studios before committing to one. The band is load bearing and it is a restraint band. At 220 a month the buyer is paying for calm, attention and space, so the campaign has to read as soft daylight, generous air, one body in one room, muted sage and oak, and type that is quiet. Push it down toward a 39 dollar high volume gym and the correct treatment inverts: bright, saturated, crowded, many bodies, heavy condensed type, price on the hero. Push it up into wellness luxury and it becomes near monochrome, editorial, almost empty, which at 220 a month reads as pretension and prices the studio out of its own neighbourhood. An agent that ships either extreme has misread the commission, and the owners have already named the failure themselves: a room that reads as a different brand from the campaign photography. A posted job of this shape runs 900 to 2,200 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2022, first studio run for four years; opening a second location on Calloway Row in a North American city. Owner led by Marit and Dana, with six instructors. Small, independent, growing to two rooms.
brand_identity.about: Verda is a boutique reformer pilates studio built on calm. One body, one room, generous air, and unhurried attention. Marit and Dana have run a single studio for four years and are now opening a second on Calloway Row. The studio is deliberately the opposite of a chain gym: no crowding, no shouting, no gloss of the everyday. What clients pay for is space, focus and a considered environment they return to.
brand_identity.audience: Considered buyers, mostly women in professional work, aged 28 to 48. They typically audition three studios before committing to one, and they are paying for calm, attention and space rather than volume or intensity.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Premium neighborhood, not luxury. Intro pack 180 dollars, membership 220 a month. Positioned above a high volume budget gym and below wellness luxury: the tone is soft daylight and quiet confidence, never pretension and never a discount.
brand_identity.typography: Quiet and editorial. A light, humanist serif for headlines paired with a restrained sans for body and labels. Generous spacing, small type, nothing condensed, bold or promotional.
brand_identity.voice: Plain, warm and unhurried. Speaks to one person rather than a crowd. Confident without hype, and honest about what the room actually is.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: No brand guidelines were ever written. The wordmark was drawn by a designer who has since left, and the only surviving file is a small low resolution web export she handed over. There is no master artwork, no color specification and no font list on record, so the freelancer inherits the studio look from this brief and from the room itself.
brand_identity.values: Calm, attention, generous space, and honesty about the room a client will actually walk into.

assets_supplied.name: studio_frames/ (2 frames, approx 4032 x 3024)
assets_supplied.kind: Two handheld phone photographs of the new Calloway Row room, taken by the owners on the late afternoon the fit out finished: one wide across the reformers toward the front window, one closer on a single reformer and the oak floor.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The only two pictures we have of the new room. Taken on our phones the afternoon the fit out finished."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The front window is fully clipped in the frame that composes best wide, so the recovery move that would bring detail back runs, reports success, and returns an image in which nothing has moved. Separately the room is under two illuminants at once, ceiling LED and street sodium coming through that window, so the sage reformer upholstery and the oak floor need opposite corrections to arrive at one daylight white point and a single global move cannot take both.

assets_supplied.name: verda_logo_web.png (600 x 600)
assets_supplied.kind: The only surviving file of the studio wordmark, a small web export left behind by the designer who drew it.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "What our old designer left. It is small and it has a white square behind it."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: It is a 600 px JPEG artefacted export with an opaque white square baked behind it, so it halos on the sage panel and cannot carry a printed card at any usable size. The artefact ring around the letterforms means an ink level selection returns a soft grey fringe rather than a clean edge, and the wordmark's two enclosed counters cannot be punched by a background removal at all.

assets_supplied.name: instructor_photos/ (6 self submitted portraits, 1100 to 4000 px)
assets_supplied.kind: Six portraits the instructors took or supplied themselves, on phones, in different rooms, for the founding member pass.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The six instructors sent their own pictures. They are what they are."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Two instructors shot against a cream studio wall wearing pale oat tops, so subject and ground sit at the same luminance and the knockout reports success while biting into a shoulder line and eating a hair fringe on one side only. A third portrait is 1100 px on the long edge, below anything the printed pass can carry, and nothing can enlarge it.

assets_supplied.name: passcard_2025_print.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: The printer's flat press PDF for last year's founding member pass, 89 x 51 mm landscape, fonts embedded, produced from a real page layout so it converts cleanly. Carries the instructor name, the class, the price, a validity line and a contact line, plus a placed portrait and the studio mark.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "What our printer sent to press last year. We do not have the working file."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The printed pass plainly shows a portrait and the studio mark as two placed pictures and four separate blocks of copy, but the mark was flattened into the card's background artwork before it went to press and the copy was set as one continuous flow. The converted document therefore exposes a single graphic frame and a single text story, nothing announces it, and any mapping authored against the second graphic frame the printed page implies is silently dropped while the preparation step still reports success.

assets_supplied.name: roster_2027.csv
assets_supplied.kind: Export from the studio's scheduling system, one row per instructor, with columns for instructor, class, price, validity, contact and a portrait filename.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The six instructors, their classes and the new prices."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: An instructor who left in the spring is still on the roster, so the export carries seven rows for six passes. The class column holds the internal scheduling codes rather than the names the studio uses with clients, and the portrait filenames carry an extension that does not match the files actually supplied.

assets_supplied.name: owner_note.txt
assets_supplied.kind: A page from Marit: the six instructors and what each teaches, the opening date history, what the campaign must not look like in her own words, and how she talks about the room.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The instructors, the classes, and what we do not want this to look like."

acceptance_bar: Everything the campaign uses reads as one afternoon in one room. One daylight white point, one black point, one warmth in the oak, one crop logic across the studio frames and the licensed frames alike.
The studio's own room is present in the campaign, not merely credited. If a studio frame could not carry the placement it was chosen for, the note says which one, why, and what carries it instead.
Nothing is cooked toward a chain gym look: no orange skin, no crushed blacks, no saturated floor. A frame taken far enough to stop looking like this room fails even if it looks impressive.

No delivered file exceeds its source frame's pixel dimensions and no crop's tradeoff record carries an upscale entry. Where a placement could not be reached by cropping, the note says what was done to that frame.
Every licensed frame is genuine photography with generative tech candidates excluded, and every licensed asset id appears in the source manifest.

The mark is placeable artwork rather than a picture of artwork: transparent, scalable with a real viewBox present, no opaque full canvas rectangle riding underneath, both counters open, and it still reads at the size the printed pass reproduces it and reversed on the sage panel.
Exactly one printed pass per current instructor, no extra pass and no missing pass. If the number shipped is not six, the note says which row was left out and why.
Every pass carries all the lines last year's pass carried, and every class name and every price on every pass is the new figure named the way the studio names it to clients, not the scheduling code.
Each per instructor file contains the pass its filename claims, established by opening it rather than by the order the files came back in, and each pass carries its own instructor's portrait.
The proofs are rendered at true print resolution at pass trim rather than at screen scale.

The launch page and the social canvases come back as one native editable document at their own canvas sizes, with every photograph actually visible, the mark as live vector shapes rather than a flattened picture, and every text element carrying its licensed face at that family's own numeric weight.

A written note: what was applied to each frame and why the studio's room and the licensed frames needed different corrections to arrive at the same place, the type system by role, every roster row questioned and its resolution, every resize any tool reported, and anything the owners should know about using the recovered mark.

Prepares six self submitted portraits to one pass treatment, including the knockout onto the studio ground where subject and wall share luminance. And recovers the wordmark at ink level out of a small artefacted web export, with the polarity decision, the enclosed counters and the vector hygiene the tracing tool does not perform.

The pairing is the agent's own art direction against a restraint band, the numeric weight per family is non standard, one bad name kills the whole kit, and the CSS must use the returned slug rather than the PostScript name.

adobe_surfaces.surface: Adobe Stock and Adobe Boards, counted as ONE surface
adobe_surfaces.tools: asset_search (StockAsset, SHORT query, contentType filter, never orientation), asset_license_and_download_stock, boards_create_new_board, boards_add_items_to_board
adobe_surfaces.role: Sources the movement and wellness photography the studio cannot shoot, IP clean and at camera scale with generative tech candidates excluded, chosen for a light that can join this room rather than for a subject. The Boards half persists the shared shortlist Marit and Dana sign off from, placed within the twelve per call cap with a partial success read as partial and vector understood to be unacceptable there.

trajectory.action: Confirm the account tier, pull the authoring playbook, and settle the split: founding member passes to the merge surface, launch page and social canvases to authored roots, photography and mark recovery to imaging.
trajectory.judgement: The passes are record per page against a layout the printer already owns; the launch page must stay editable because the opening date moves, which the merge surface structurally cannot give.
trajectory.produces: A written plan naming surface per deliverable and the confirmed account tier.

trajectory.action: Upload the two studio frames, the logo export, the six instructor portraits, the press PDF, the roster export and the owner's note, holding each presigned URL.
trajectory.judgement: A manifest keyed by role and by instructor, because several of these files will exist in three or four states before the end.
trajectory.produces: A manifest of presigned URLs keyed by role.

trajectory.action: Preview everything and triage: what light each studio frame is actually under, which portraits have a separable subject and which do not, what the logo export really is at pixel level, and what native aspect each frame can reach.
trajectory.judgement: The owners describe dusk, which is a time rather than a diagnosis. Two illuminants in one room, a portrait whose subject and wall share a value, and an artefact ring around a wordmark are three different problems needing three different instruments.
trajectory.produces: A triage note per asset: illuminant, separability, native scale and boundary type.

trajectory.action: Straighten what is off level, then set a calm daylight base on the two studio frames, using confined corrections where the sage upholstery and the oak floor pull opposite ways under the mixed light.
trajectory.judgement: Straightening reframes and eats edge pixels before any crop is locked. Naming a material's own visual properties confines the correction; naming the object it sits in takes the whole room with it.
trajectory.produces: Levelled studio masters at a calm daylight base with the applied parameters recorded per frame.

trajectory.action: Work the front window in the wide composing studio frame, since the daylight the campaign is about is the light coming through it.
trajectory.judgement: Whether there is anything under that window to bring back is a property of one phone exposure at dusk, and there is no measurement available anywhere to establish it in advance.
trajectory.produces: An attempted recovery on the wide studio frame and an honest look at the result.

trajectory.action: Search with short generic queries, filter to photography, exclude generative tech candidates, and build two defensible shortlists as two moods rather than one pile, then argue the pick against the band.
trajectory.judgement: Long descriptive queries return nothing and the orientation filter always returns zero, so neither is used. The choice is art direction: which light could plausibly be this room, not which thumbnail is prettiest.
trajectory.produces: Two shortlists, a defended pick, and the reasoning recorded.

trajectory.action: License the chosen frames and download each at full resolution immediately, recording asset ids and the generative tech flag.
trajectory.judgement: The download link is short lived and re licensing only refreshes the URL. Camera scale matters because every later placement can only crop down.
trajectory.produces: Licensed camera scale frames on disk with a source manifest.

trajectory.action: Grade the licensed frames toward the calm daylight target and lay them beside the graded studio frames exactly as the launch page will lay them.
trajectory.judgement: This is the first moment the licensed photography and the studio's own room are adjacent, and it is the only moment the question the owners actually asked can be answered.
trajectory.produces: A campaign contact set judged as one set, with the reasoning recorded.

trajectory.action: Recover the wordmark from the web export: an ink level selection naming the letterforms' own visual properties, correct polarity, a bounds crop from the selection's own bbox, a trace, then a viewBox injected and the opaque full canvas ground path removed, plus a reversed variant for the sage panel.
trajectory.judgement: Three decisions no tool makes: how to word the selection so it takes ink rather than the white plate, which polarity to trace, and whether the two enclosed counters came back open or came back filled and plausible. Background removal is the wrong instrument on an enclosed counter.
trajectory.produces: A placeable, scalable, transparent wordmark plus a reversed variant.

trajectory.action: Prepare the six instructor portraits to one pass treatment: subject aware crops that never enlarge, then the knockout onto the studio's solid ground, reading confidence and tradeoffs on every call.
trajectory.judgement: A portrait below the pass's own reproduction scale cannot be rescued and has to be handled as a client conversation rather than a tool call. Where subject and wall share a luminance, the knockout is where the craft is.
trajectory.produces: Six prepared portraits on the studio ground, plus a note on any that could not reach pass scale.

trajectory.surface: Data preparation and Creative Cloud storage
trajectory.action: Reconcile the roster against the owner's note, normalise it into a merge shaped data file with an at prefixed image column holding bare filenames matching the prepared portraits, upload those portraits and build the image map.
trajectory.judgement: Real reconciliation: a departed instructor is still on the export, the class column holds internal codes rather than client facing names, and the filenames do not match the files. What is the agent's call and what is Marit's to confirm has to be said rather than done silently.
trajectory.produces: The merge data file, the uploaded portraits, the image map and a list of roster questions.

trajectory.action: Convert the press PDF, export the interchange file, unzip it and read the real frame inventory, the integer page item ids and the bounds of every frame, then reconstruct the card's true story text from its concatenated content runs.
trajectory.judgement: What the printed card looks like is not evidence of what the document contains, and the offsets must be computed from the document rather than from any convenience readout.
trajectory.produces: The converted document, its interchange export, a real frame inventory with bounds, and a reconstructed story string.

trajectory.action: Author the mapping covering every copy field and every graphic frame that actually exists, validate it, prepare the template, then export the interchange file from the RESULT and search for every placeholder the mapping claimed to create.
trajectory.judgement: Not accepting a success message as evidence, and ordering any rows sharing a uid so their positions hold against the original text. Which frame carries the portrait is settled by bounds and link, not by assumption.
trajectory.produces: A prepared template whose placeholder inventory has been independently confirmed.

trajectory.action: Merge to a native document with the per row portraits bound, then render the pass run and the owners' proofs at true print resolution from that document, and produce the per instructor files, naming each by opening it.
trajectory.judgement: Merging to the native document first keeps both branches open, and identity by position in a returned list is the fast wrong answer that prints an instructor's name over another instructor's face.
trajectory.produces: The pass run, print resolution proofs, and per instructor files verified by inspection.

trajectory.action: Read every rendered pass at trim rather than at proof scale, line by line, price by price and portrait by portrait, and look at the recovered mark where it actually sits on the card.
trajectory.judgement: Reading the output rather than the log. A missing line, a scheduling code where a class name should be, and a mark that has stopped reading all look like success at the API boundary.
trajectory.produces: A pass by pass reconciliation and an honest look at the mark at its real reproduction size.

trajectory.action: Ask for recommendations once per role, pull the style inventories for the real numeric weights, launder every name into canonical form, and build one kit.
trajectory.judgement: The pairing is the agent's own and has to land on restraint at 220 a month, neither gym nor luxury. The weight cannot be inferred from a style name and a display cut is reached by its own slug.
trajectory.produces: A one kit type system with family, foundry and actual numeric weight per role.

trajectory.action: Author one self contained HTML with the launch page, the wide hero and the 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 social canvases, inline every photograph as image data, place the wordmark as inline SVG inside an explicitly sized top left anchored wrapper including reversed on the sage panel, declare family and weight per text element, then upload and hold the URL.
trajectory.judgement: A photograph left as a URL is not a photograph, an auto sized right anchored wrapper throws its contents off the canvas, and a global canvas override collapses a mixed size set. The design work is how much air a restraint band takes and how quietly the mark is used.
trajectory.produces: One export ready HTML carrying the whole campaign set, retained as the durable source.

trajectory.action: Run the readiness check, export by URL, verify canvas one from the document's rendition and every other canvas from the returned per canvas markup, asserting that every image resolved to real image data and that the wordmark arrived as vector paths.
trajectory.judgement: Every drop this importer performs returns success with no warning, and the rendition shows the first artboard only.
trajectory.produces: A native editable document, an inspected first canvas and a per canvas markup audit.

trajectory.action: Persist the shared shortlist board within the placement cap, re sending only entries named as failed, then write the note.
trajectory.judgement: A 201 is partial success and the vector wordmark is not boardable, so it belongs in the note. The note has to name every roster row questioned and everything the owners need to know about the recovered mark.
trajectory.produces: A persistent shareable board with nothing silently dropped, and the written handover.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the front window in the wide composing studio frame has anything left in it. The recovery move runs, reports success, and returns an image in which the readout is that nothing has moved: the window is clipped in every channel, so there is no detail under it to lift and the tool has nothing to do. Every later move toward the calm daylight target then pushes the rest of the room while that rectangle stays flat white, and it gets worse rather than better as the room around it comes down to a daylight value. There is no histogram, no eyedropper and no measurement anywhere in the connector, so whether a phone exposure at dusk held the window is unknowable until the attempt is made and the result is looked at.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it and no care prevents it, because the only channel that reports on this exposure is the attempt itself, and the frame that composes best wide is the frame with the window in it. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says the two pictures were taken on phones on a late afternoon, which is the owners' account of when they were taken, and asks for calm daylight, which is the requirement. Neither is a disclosure that a channel is clipped. (c) It is not a propagation re run: the answer changes what the campaign's lead picture is a picture of.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re frame that studio master so the window falls outside the wide hero, which changes what the room's wide picture is about and therefore the crop logic for the whole set, or demote it and let a licensed frame lead, which changes how much of the campaign is the studio's own room and forces the calm daylight target to be re fixed off licensed photography rather than off the client's room, with every frame already corrected toward the old target re corrected afterwards.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The launch page ships with a flat white rectangle where the studio's daylight window should be, on the single picture a considered buyer looks at while deciding between three studios, and the effect grows more obvious the more correctly the rest of the room is graded.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the licensed frame can actually join this room. The search surface returns a 240 px thumbnail plus true dimensions and nothing else about the light, so a frame that reads on the thumbnail as soft north light can turn out at full resolution to be lit by a large warm practical off frame, laying an amber ramp across the far wall and a warm cast into the skin. Brought toward the calm daylight target globally, the skin goes cold before the wall gives up its amber; confined to the wall, the wall's new neutral changes what the sage reformer beside it reads as. Whether the frame joins at all only becomes a question at the moment it is downloaded at full resolution and laid beside the graded studio frames, which is the first time the two have ever been adjacent.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot produce that adjacency earlier, because it requires both the licence and the grade, and the pre licence readout is a 240 px proxy with no colour information worth trusting. (b) Nothing states it: the brief asks for frames chosen the way a designer chooses and for everything to look like one afternoon, which is the requirement rather than the finding. (c) It is not a propagation re run: the response is to license a different asset, which is a new shortlist, a new defence and a different lead picture.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Return to the search with what the failure taught about which lights can honestly join this room, license a replacement, grade it toward the target, re judge the whole set adjacent, and if no candidate joins, re fix the target on what the studio's own room can honestly be and re correct the licensed frames toward that instead, recording in the note why the studio frames and the licensed frames needed different corrections to arrive at the same place.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The campaign's most prominent photograph carries warm practical light and warm skin against a cool sage room, which is exactly the different brand from the campaign photography that the owners said in writing would waste the money.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the printer's press card actually converts to. The printed pass plainly shows a portrait and the studio mark as two placed pictures and four separate blocks of copy, so the obvious plan binds a per row portrait to one graphic frame and the mark to the other and maps four fields to four frames. The converted document exposes one graphic frame and one continuous text story, because the mark was flattened into the background artwork before the file went to press and the copy was set as a single flow. Frame granularity is a property of how a retired printer built the document, it is announced nowhere, and the printed card is actively misleading about it. Any mapping row aimed at the second graphic frame is silently filtered out for naming an id that does not exist, the validator returns valid on what remains, and the preparation step reports success.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot dodge it, because the inventory does not exist until the conversion has run, and the only visible evidence beforehand is the printed page, which contradicts it. (b) Nothing states it: the brief says only that the printer holds the file that went to press. (c) It is not a propagation re run: the mapping strategy changes from per frame binding to offset arithmetic inside one story with same uid rows ordered so their positions hold, the mark can no longer be swapped per card and has to be carried some other way, and the portrait's aspect is now set by the single surviving graphic frame rather than by the two the plan assumed, which sends the portrait preparation back to the imaging surface.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Recompute every copy offset against the story text reconstructed from the exported document, re author the mapping inside one flow with same uid rows in descending position order, re prepare the six portraits to the aspect the surviving graphic frame actually has, decide and state how the recovered mark reaches the pass given that the old one is baked into the background, and verify by exporting the interchange file from the prepared template and searching for every placeholder before any pass is merged.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The founding member passes print with each instructor's portrait squeezed to the wrong shape in the only frame that exists, two copy fields never replaced so every pass carries last year's class name and price, and the studio mark stuck at whatever the printer flattened in a year ago.

deliverables.name: Verda campaign photography, the studio's own room plus the licensed movement set
deliverables.spec: Two studio frames and the licensed frames brought to one calm daylight target (one white point, one black point, one warmth in the oak, one crop logic) without crossing the owners' stated do not want line, delivered as one wide hero and 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 placements. Every output at or below its source dimensions, accompanied by a source and licensing manifest carrying every asset id with generative tech candidates excluded, and a parameter log naming why the studio's room and the licensed photography needed different corrections to reach the same place.

deliverables.name: Instructor portrait set on the studio ground

decision_gates: Which deliverables go to the merge surface and which to authored canvases, given a pass the printer already owns and an opening date that keeps moving.
Whether the mixed dusk light in the room is one problem or two, since the sage upholstery and the oak floor pull opposite ways toward one white point.
Whether the wide composing studio frame can carry the wide hero at all once the window is worked, and what leads the campaign if it cannot.
Which two moods to shortlist from Stock and which to defend, at a band where the wrong light is not merely different but off brand.
Whether a licensed frame that will not join the room is the frame's problem or the target's, and therefore whether the target moves.

Selection prompt wording on the logo export: naming the plate takes the white square, naming the letterforms' own visual properties takes the ink, and background removal on an enclosed counter is the wrong instrument entirely.
Whether the recovered wordmark came back with open counters or came back filled and plausible, which only shows when it is placed small on the pass.
How the portrait below pass scale is handled, given that nothing can enlarge it and the client expects six passes.
The roster: a departed instructor still on the export, internal codes where client facing class names belong, and filenames that do not match the files. What is the agent's call and what is Marit's.
Whether to trust the printed card's apparent structure or the converted document's real frame inventory, and whether a success message counts as verification.

The type pairing, which the recommender refuses to make, judged against restraint at 220 a month rather than against gym energy or luxury signalling.
why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns lovely pictures of a pilates studio. IDENTITY: the campaign has to contain the actual Calloway Row room that a considered buyer will walk into after visiting two competitors, and the owners have named the mismatch between room and campaign as the failure that wastes the money; a regenerated studio is a misrepresentation. The six instructors are six real people whose faces go on a printed pass, and the wordmark is a specific drawing that must be RECOVERED from the only surviving file, not reinvented into a different studio's mark. LICENSING: the sourced photography has to be genuinely licensed, provenance clear and free of generative tech candidates, because it runs in paid placement. SPEC: the printed run needs one 89 x 51 mm pass per current instructor binding class and price verbatim, per instructor files each containing the pass they claim, and proofs at true print resolution. EDITABILITY: the launch set is defined by being editable, because the opening date has already moved once. And the middle of the engagement is verification against material reality: whether a dusk exposure held its window, whether a licensed frame's real light can join this room, whether a placeholder was ever created.
doability_proof: Every link is verified live in CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10, auth account), five surfaces honestly counted, no banned capability and no dead surface. IMAGING: straighten, apply_adjustments global and masked, select_by_prompt with returnBbox, invert_selection, crop_to_bounds, crop_and_resize with its tradeoffs and 2x upscale cap, remove_background in both transparent and backgroundColor forms, fill_area and vectorize are verified headless across 27 live calls. The window checkpoint rests on there being NO measurement anywhere in the family (no eyedropper, no histogram, no ruler; metadata.bbox is a mask extent only), so recovery is an eye judgement and a null result is indistinguishable from a success at the API boundary. The portrait checkpoint rests on the verified alpha behaviour of remove_background (118,823 opaque and 13,371 genuinely feathered partial alpha px preserved through both crop tools at outputFileType png) and on the verified silent downscale of oversized inputs reported only through a tradeoffs entry. The mark recovery rests on the verified substrate versus ink prompt asymmetry (naming the card selected the card at 154,926 px; naming the ink's own colour and medium selected the strokes at 9,372 px), the verified polarity trap before vectorize, the verified solid disc failure of remove_background on an enclosed interior, image_vectorize TAKING NO OPTIONS AT ALL so raster preparation is the only lever, and the missing viewBox plus opaque path zero that the acceptance bar scores. MERGE SPINE: building a merge template from a bare press PDF end to end headlessly is verified; one record per page is confirmed for the PDF branch; per record files are confirmed in correct order by two routes (createSeparateFiles and a recordRange loop) while multi record PNG or JPEG URLs are verified to come back REVERSED, which is why identity is established by opening the file; true 300 DPI at trim is confirmed through document_render_layout while the merge's own resolution parameter is documented as silently ignored; per row image binding through an at prefixed CSV column plus additionalImageFiles is verified visually. The frame granularity checkpoint rests on two verified findings: FRAME GRANULARITY FROM A PDF IS NOT UNDER YOUR CONTROL AND CAN COLLAPSE TO ONE FRAME (a continuous flow converted to exactly one TextFrame and zero graphic frames), and a mapping row whose uid does not resolve is DROPPED FROM filteredMappings while prepare_indd_merge_template still returns Create Placeholder completed successfully. EXPRESS: mixed canvas sizes in one export, inline SVG becoming native editable vector, and a genuine editable document are verified; the rendition shows PAGE 1 ONLY so verification splits between rendition and returned markup; every external image URL resolves to a placeholder grey box so photographs must be base64 inlined, and the payload is routed by uploaded URL because inlined photography passes the 70 KB threshold. FONTS follow the verified chain with find_fonts laundering names, font_styles supplying non standard numeric weights, and css_stack slugs in the CSS. STOCK and BOARDS follow the verified chain with short queries, orientation never passed, isGenTech exposed for exclusion, and the twelve per call board cap where 201 means partial. AVOIDED: no video or audio, no vector render or vector merge, no upscaling, no object removal, no compositing, no OCR, no bleed or press preset gate, no variable QR, no fill_text, no animate_design, no replace_image, no photo reaching Express as a URL, no batch above 20.
